essence: All teaching emanating from the guru's mouth counts as scripture.
Even with a large retinue, the disciple must remain greatly devoted.
The disciple should obey the guru's command with his whole inner being.
The disciple should constantly serve while in the guru's presence.
The disciple should stand on a low seat and perform the guru's work.
